signal_functions.role: reads the five OHLCV passthrough values and delegates to the decision engine
updates RDV history and emits BUY, SELL, or HOLD

signal_dependencies.entry_condition: bar-start position == 0 and previous RDV > et_long and volume > 0
signal_dependencies.exit_condition: bar-start position == 1 and bars_since_entry > 0 and previous RDV < 0 and volume > 0
signal_dependencies.temporal_semantics: RDV decisions use RDV[1]; entry and exit are mutually exclusive on one update

entry_price_source: No entry price is stored or returned. The source strategy documentation says entry at Open, while the current string signal carries no price.
exit_price_source: No exit price is stored or returned. The source strategy documentation says exit at Open, while the current string signal carries no price.
execution_assumptions: A BUY signal is treated as a filled long before ReferenceDeviationLongEngine.update returns.
A SELL signal is treated as a completed flatten before ReferenceDeviationLongEngine.update returns.
No rejected, partial, delayed, or missing fill can be represented in the internal position state.
The strategy does not modify cash, equity, commission, funding, or PnL.
The existing backend separately converts BUY/SELL/HOLD to intents and owns fill accounting.
